film.title: The mirrored form
film.caption: The mirrored form. A 24-second silent camera study, rendered in TouchDesigner. 720p, 24 fps.

stills.title: The Lantern
stills.caption: Two mirrored halves, rendered in copper and teal.
stills.alt: Porous Lantern: two porous mirrored forms in copper and teal meeting along a central plane

stills.title: Mirror partners
stills.caption: The complete silhouette and its paired openings.
stills.alt: The complete mirrored Lantern with matching openings on either side of the central interface

stills.title: In profile
stills.caption: An oblique view reveals the depth of the two halves.
stills.alt: An oblique view of the mirrored Lantern showing its curved spatial forms

stills.title: The other side
stills.caption: The reverse of the same fixed geometry.
stills.alt: The back of the mirrored Lantern, with teal on the left and copper on the right

stills.title: At the interface
stills.caption: Matching boundary traces meet at the plane of reflection.
stills.alt: A close view of copper and teal fractal branches meeting at the central interface

stills.title: Within
stills.caption: A closer view inside the copper half reveals repeated recursive motifs.
stills.alt: Small ring-like recursive forms within the copper half of Porous Lantern
